https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0006-PPSA19534_00-SANTIAGOSTANDARD

Descend and dominate in Season 2 Nightfall, deploying across Battlefield 6 and REDSEC.

Enter Hagental Base, a new infantry-only underground map built for intense close-quarters combat. When the lights go out in Hagental Base: Nightfall, low visibility transforms the tunnels into a fight for survival.

Gear up with the CZ3A1 SMG and the fully automatic vz. 61 sidearm. Weave your way through the battle on the M1030-M1 and TM/O 450 Dirt Bikes, equipped with two seats for swift flanking maneuvers and quick getaways.

In REDSEC, Gauntlet: Nightfall brings darkness-enhanced combat to Hagental Base, while Defense Testing Complex 3 expands Fort Lyndon with a new subterranean sector designed for high-stakes close-quarters combat and higher rarity loot.

Step into the dark.

Enter Kusan: City of Wolves — a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption.

This demo is a focused slice of the full game: fast, unforgiving combat where one mistake means death. Master sharp gunplay, perfect your movement, chain clean combos with the Quantum Knife and War Hand, and smash the environment to uncover Bolts you can spend on upgrades.

Every moment is intensified by an adrenaline fuelled soundtrack from Loptimist, a heavyweight in Korean hip hop, drenched in head bopping loops and deep 808s that push you forward without mercy.
